product_one_liner.value: nudge is a financial-wellbeing platform for employers to provide employees with personalized financial education, guidance, tools and action plans.

pricing_page.notes: No public plans/pricing page was found; the FAQ directs buyers to contact nudge for tailored pricing.

employee_band.notes: PitchBook reports 116 employees as of 2026; LeadIQ reports approximately 117 as of October 2026.

eng_blog.notes: The public news/blog stream contains marketing, financial-wellbeing and company/product announcements, not a qualifying engineering blog.

public_docs.notes: No public documentation/help portal link was found; the public FAQ and implementation guide do not constitute a multi-article documentation portal.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The live board lists Strategic Account Executive and Senior Software Engineer; neither is a qualifying AI/ML/data-science title.

model_provider.value: Microsoft Azure AI; Google AI; IBM AI Engineering
model_provider.notes: The security page names these enterprise API providers for LLMs in client-facing services, without naming specific models.

compliance_certs.notes: ISO 27001 is described as certified; GDPR is a claimed compliance framework, not itself a certification.

last_funding.notes: LeadIQ reports $7 million; Dealroom reports the round as £5 million. The company announcement confirms Kennet investment on March 16, 2021 but does not disclose an amount.

raised_18mo.notes: The latest documented round is March 2021, before the May 9, 2025–November 9, 2026 window.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: Live title: Strategic Account Executive; the role focuses on existing enterprise-client retention, renewal and expansion.

launched_6mo.notes: September 1, 2026: introduced personalized financial action plans powered by numa, within the May 9–November 9, 2026 window.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: October 15, 2026 announcement: Debi Kesselring and Greg Goebert appointed Vice Presidents, U.S., within the November 9, 2025–November 9, 2026 window.

crm_stack_signal.notes: The CMO describes nudge sales and marketing processes as underpinned by HubSpot; the privacy page also identifies HubSpot marketing tracking.
